mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits (HOUST) above 550.0 thousand units signals robust housing market activity, driving consumer confidence and corporate investment, which produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST exceeds 550.0 but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.25% for two consecutive months, it signals the end of accommodative monetary policy, compressing equity valuations through higher discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 0.25% for two months but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in labor market strength (PAYEMS) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates robust economic growth, driving higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS and RSAFS both increase > 0.5% but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) signals weakening manufacturing output, leading to reduced corporate profitability expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during contraction phases.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 95.0 but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained annual increase in CPIAUCSL above 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting market anticipation of aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annually but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates severe labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 9.0% for two months but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 550.0) combined with stable monetary policy (FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%) indicates favorable growth conditions without rate hikes, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 550.0 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery phase (UNRATE declining > 0.2% in 3 months), rising employment boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE declines > 0.2% in 3 months but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of cases.
